## Description

Pilot R4 on flags; collect evidence: 10 consecutive days of zero unexplained cash variance; adviser-approved invoice formats; 0 abnormal results unacknowledged > 72 h; ≥ 30 % bookings confirmed by patients via portal/WhatsApp. Release notes; journeys J1 (billing) and J5 (results loop) pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Evidence for all four exit criteria attached and confirmed.
- [ ] **AC2.** Clinical safety reviewer signs the release (results loop and portal release rules).
- [ ] **AC3.** R4 release notes list P4-01…P4-10 status and exclusions (insurance claims, teleconsultation).
- [ ] **AC4.** Playwright J1 billing step and J5 delayed-result journey pass.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
